senses.gloss:
Bhagapūjāvidhi
from Kālikāpurāṇa. SB. New D.. VI. 26354 (inc.).

Bhāgapañcāṅga
a set of mathematical tables described on the outside a. a mode of computing the calender for lunar time. Br. Mus. 473.
For a. analysis of the set of tables, see D. Pingree, Skt. Astr. tables in England, p.. 182-86.
See also Sen, Bibli. of Astron. p. 18.
